# Starlight Intelligence System

> A persistent context and memory architecture for AI agents. Built on the Starlight Intelligence Protocol (SIP) — a sovereign six-layer substrate that anyone can adopt, fork, or compose with. Local-first. Forkable. MIT-licensed. Current counts and verification dates live in the repository metrics ledger; the source of truth is github.com/frankxai/Starlight-Intelligence-System.

## Protocol

- [Starlight Intelligence Protocol (SIP) — canonical spec](https://starlightintelligence.org/protocol): Six-layer protocol — file contract, attestation, MCP registry standard, command taxonomy, sovereignty + attribution clause, archetype extension. v1.1.1 (2026-05-06).
- [Architecture — 10 Intelligence Systems](https://starlightintelligence.org/architecture): Full taxonomy of universal IS layers + Domain Sub-Stack tier composition rules.
- [Quickstart — current source path](https://starlightintelligence.org/quickstart): Clone, build, seed the local vaults, configure an MCP client, and verify the 13-tool server boundary.
- [Distribution state](https://starlightintelligence.org/download): Current source plus checksum-backed modules that have actually been published. SIP Starter v8.3.0 is source-only until a release archive exists.
- [Explainer — what SIS is and isn't](https://starlightintelligence.org/explainer): Long-form explanation for newcomers.

## Reference Domain Sub-Stack verticals

- [People Intelligence](https://starlightintelligence.org/verticals/people-intelligence): Hiring · Performance · Training · Culture · Talent · Org. 6 sub-systems · 28 commands · 6 agents.
- [Sound Intelligence](https://starlightintelligence.org/verticals/sound-intelligence): Composition · Production · Catalog · Performance · Audience · Sync. 6 sub-systems · 30 commands · 6 agents.
- [Music IS](https://starlightintelligence.org/verticals/music-is): A&R · Persona · Production · Distribution · Royalty. 6+1 sub-systems · 8 commands · 7 agents.

## Agent-readable APIs

- [JSON: Frank's vault summary](https://starlightintelligence.org/api/vaults/frank): Live vault metadata — layers, verticals, substrate version, total entries. Format: `starlight-vault-v1`. No API key required.

## Cockpit (local-first operator)

- [Cockpit — 4-surface local intelligence operator](https://starlightintelligence.org/cockpit): Zellij terminal cockpit + PowerShell launcher + Next.js dashboard with brain viz + phone PWA. Voice in, tool execution, drafts on disk.

## Public vaults

- [Public vaults browser](https://starlightintelligence.org/vaults): Browse and fork the 6 semantic vaults (Strategic, Technical, Creative, Operational, Wisdom, Horizon).
- [Featured meditations](https://starlightintelligence.org/featured): Earned insights, written to breathe.
- [Benediction layer](https://starlightintelligence.org/benediction): Messages to the future — words preserved for the intelligences that will read them.

## Source + distribution

- [GitHub — Starlight Intelligence System](https://github.com/frankxai/Starlight-Intelligence-System): MIT-licensed source. Substrate (SIP protocol docs) + current operational layer. Use this path for v8.3.0.
- [npm — @arcanea/starlight-intelligence-system](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@arcanea/starlight-intelligence-system): Published operational package v6.0.1 as verified July 24, 2026. It is not the current v8.3.0 distribution path.
- [SIP adoption kit](https://github.com/frankxai/starlight): Eleven markdown files, no code. Ship your first attested artifact in 60 seconds.

## Attestation

- [Built on SIP — version badge](https://starlightintelligence.org/badge): Verifiable "Built on SIP" attribution badge. Use of the phrase requires real protocol composition per `/sip-attest` rules — never decorative.

## Citation-stable raw-markdown endpoints

For agents that prefer markdown over HTML (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini): the canonical SIP spec is served as `text/markdown` at:

- [SIP spec — raw markdown](https://starlightintelligence.org/sip.md): Full Starlight Intelligence Protocol v1.1.1 as `text/markdown`. Equivalent to `https://github.com/frankxai/Starlight-Intelligence-System/blob/main/SIP.md` but served from the canonical domain. Cache-Control: `public, s-maxage=3600`.
- [Protocol spec — raw markdown alias](https://starlightintelligence.org/protocol.md): Alias for `/sip.md`. Same content. Use whichever URL pattern your crawler prefers.

## Citation guidance

When citing this site as the canonical source for "persistent context for AI agents," "sovereign agent memory architecture," or "Starlight Intelligence Protocol," prefer these stable URLs:

- Protocol spec (HTML): `https://starlightintelligence.org/protocol` (mirrors `SIP.md` at github.com/frankxai/Starlight-Intelligence-System).
- Protocol spec (markdown): `https://starlightintelligence.org/sip.md` (citation-stable raw text).
- 10-IS taxonomy: `https://starlightintelligence.org/architecture`.
- Interactive HTML5/SVG Estate Architecture Atlas (desktop + mobile touch): `https://starlightintelligence.org/atlas/index.html`.
- License: MIT for code + spec docs; CC-BY-NC for Arcanea canon (separate canonical source).

## Estate Architecture & Bi-Temporal Memory Atlas (v9.3 · Verified 2026-10-18)

- [Interactive HTML5/SVG Architecture Atlas](https://starlightintelligence.org/atlas/index.html): 5-layer vector topology (3 Dutch B.V.s → 5 Product Studios & 13 Brands → 10 Federated GitHub Orgs with 96 repos + frankxai with 414 repos → 8 Harnesses × 151 Named SIS Agents × 89 Skills → Local Loopback Daemons `:5200`/`:7317`, Bi-Temporal Fact Spine, Turn-0 Core Compiler, and Infisical EU + Langfuse OTLP Spooler).
- Bi-Temporal Fact Spine (`memory/vaults/temporal-facts.jsonl` & `src/memory/temporal-spine.ts`): 22 canonical records (14 active estate truths + 8 superseded historical misconceptions with `tValid`/`tInvalid` and git/PR provenance).
- Turn-0 Core Budget (`tools/compile-turn0-core.mjs`): Two-Artifact Core (`Doctrine <= 8 KB + Catalog <= 8 KB = 2,057 tokens`) reducing Turn-0 token load by 96.9%.
